media:group.media:description:

entry.title: ENGL SAVAGE 30 – Small Amp, Serious Chug

media:group.media:title: ENGL SAVAGE 30 – Small Amp, Serious Chug
media:group.media:description:
The ENGL Savage 120 was my main live amp for years. Now I'm checking out the new ENGL Savage 30 (E611) — a smaller, 30-watt take on an amp I've always had a soft spot for.
In this episode of Ola Testing Shit, I run through the controls, talk about the EL34 power section, and put the lead channel through plenty of riffs and chugs. I test the low/high gain modes, contour switch and depth boost, try some different tunings with the Chug Capo, and yes... check the clean channel too.
Does it still have that Savage feel? Let's find out.
Would you go for the Savage 30 or the original Savage 120? Let me know in the comments.

entry.title: SWOLA303 - SLAYER REIGN IN BLOOD 40 YEARS, I WENT TO BRAZIL, BEHEMOTH, IBANEZ PII

media:group.media:title: SWOLA303 - SLAYER REIGN IN BLOOD 40 YEARS, I WENT TO BRAZIL, BEHEMOTH, IBANEZ PII
media:group.media:description:
Sunday With Ola 303!
This week we’re talking about Slayer celebrating 40 years of Reign In Blood by playing the entire album live, Behemoth teaming up with Shagrath from Dimmu Borgir, new music from Alissa White-Gluz and Blue Medusa, Ibanez continuing their ridiculous run of new guitars, and the new IK Multimedia TONEX Board.
We also check out the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra performing Finnish metal classics on national television, including music from Children of Bodom.
In Adventures With Ola I show you the compact touring pedalboard I’m using in South America with the Quad Cortex Mini and Darkglass MIDI pedal.
And finally, come along for the first day of our South American tour as The Haunted lands in São Paulo, Brazil and plays the first show of the run.
